2607.25911.title: AnnoBench: A Benchmark for Visualization Annotation Generation
2607.25911.paper_summary: Annotation is among the most demanding visualization tasks to automate, as it simultaneously requires correctly navigating visual, semantic, and stylistic constraints. Failure to meet any of these conditions severely undermines the utility of an annotation, rendering it challenging to read, inaccurate, or visually discordant. Despite a growing body of annotation tools and automations, no existing benchmark or evaluation framework tests whether these conditions are met because of their scope and annotation not being the focus of their studies. We introduce AnnoBench, a benchmark for visualization annotation that materializes the inherent challenges of this domain in a structured and testable manner. AnnoBench pairs visualizations from professional data journalism and visualization galleries with annotation tasks, spanning four representation formats, five chart description conditions, and two prompt specification levels. The benchmark is executed via VLM-as-a-judge, using models aligned with manual human assessment. We evaluate the benchmark via four one-factor-at-a-time experiments, exploring the effects of input representation, semantic context, and prompt specificity, and model selection on annotation quality. This work provides a foundation for advancing annotation automation, tooling, and visualization-generation pipelines.
2607.25911.paper_summary_zh: 註解是自動化中最具挑戰性的視覺化任務之一，因為它同時需要正確地導航視覺、語義和風格約束。未能滿足這些條件中的任何一項會嚴重削弱註解的實用性，使其難以閱讀、不準確或在視覺上不協調。儘管註解工具和自動化的數量日益增加，但目前沒有現有的基準或評估框架來測試這些條件是否得到滿足，因為它們的範疇和註解並不是研究的重點。我們介紹了AnnoBench，這是一個視覺化註解的基準，以結構化和可測試的方式具現化該領域固有的挑戰。AnnoBench 將專業數據新聞和視覺化畫廊中的視覺化與註解任務配對，涵蓋四種表示格式、五種圖表描述條件和兩個提示規範級別。該基準通過 VLM-as-a-judge 執行，使用與人工評估對齊的模型。我們通過四個單因素實驗來評估基準，探索輸入表示、語義上下文、提示具體性和模型選擇對註解質量的影響。這項工作為推進註解自動化、工具和視覺化生成管道提供了基礎。
